architecture_contract.warning: ALiBi permits extrapolation beyond the pretraining length, but arbitrary-length wording is not an empirical guarantee. The common lane must freeze a tested sequence length and reject any tokenizer overflow or silent truncation.

input_contract.boundary_warning: A single allele change can alter BPE segmentation. Token offsets must be recovered for each allele and mapped back to base coordinates; token indices cannot be assumed comparable.

representation_and_task_contract.common_lane: Map final-layer token states to covered bases, mean-pool a fixed 1536-bp variant-centered region for REF and ALT, average forward and reverse-complement representations after coordinate realignment, and pass the frozen REF, ALT, ALT-minus-REF, and absolute-difference vector to the identical linear and two-layer heads.
representation_and_task_contract.native_zero_shot_lane: Length-normalized masked pseudo-log-likelihood difference for ALT versus REF, reported separately because allele-dependent BPE segmentation can confound the score.
representation_and_task_contract.signed_effect_limit: Sequence likelihood does not identify the direction of a cell-type eQTL or ieQTL effect. A supervised signed-effect head requires a separately registered development label source; GSE289173 cannot be used for fitting or calibration.

runtime_contract.warning: The Hugging Face object executes pinned custom code and includes a Triton FlashAttention implementation. No trust_remote_code fetch is allowed during a run; reviewed files must be vendored and hashed.

source_evidence: The ICLR 2024 paper, pinned official code, and exact Hugging Face revision were queried on 2026-08-22. Only public text, configuration, tokenizer metadata, and file metadata were read; checkpoint bytes were not downloaded or deserialized.
